integrity: No independent audit performed. Source first-public date is the arXiv version-one posting on 2023-04-26.
scientific_limitations: Applies to simple graphs with at least one triangle and no four-cycle (including chorded four-cycles), n>=7; no claim for graphs with four-cycles, equivariance, or shellability. The uniform proof uses integral collapse and duality, supported but not replaced by finite examples.
title: Three-cut complexes of four-cycle-free graphs with triangles
